svg.title: Trellis architecture: the rings and their projects
svg.desc: The rings of a default Trellis solution as cards holding each project's folders and files: Presentation (Api, Api.Common, Api.Contracts, UI.Common, UI.Web); Infrastructure and Persistence, peers that never reference each other; Core (Application, Domain, SharedKernel); Shared (ServiceDefaults) and tools (AppHost, MigrationService, Analyzers). Arrows show references, all pointing inward. The Invoices slice is expanded in every project that has it.
svg.text: driving adapters: the HTTP API and the Blazor UI

driven adapters: EF Core, Identity, the outbox
